response.sql:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name,
         AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT Name, rate,
       rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS relative_rate
FROM rates;

assumptions.assumption: Each media type is counted once by MediaTypeId; types with no matched tracks are omitted, and AVG skips missing per-track ratios (and null type rates in the overall mean).
